system.prerequisites: Ability to cast a spell with the Healing trait, Medicine 3 ranks, Mental Focus 2 ranks
system.description:
ADEPT

Your understanding of healing has reached an uncomfortable conclusion: sometimes the quickest way to save another person is to suffer in their place.
You gain the Share the Wound action:
SHARE THE WOUND
FOCUS HEALING SOUL
Action R; Trigger An ally within 30 feet suffers HP damage.
After the damage has been determined, reduce the HP damage suffered by the ally by an amount up to your level + your magical ability modifier. You lose the same number of Hit Points.
This HP loss cannot be reduced by Resistance, Base DR, temporary HP or another effect and cannot itself be redirected to another creature.
You cannot use Share the Wound if doing so would reduce you below 1 HP.

Prerequisites Ability to cast a spell with the Healing trait, Medicine 3 ranks, Mental Focus 2 ranks

Progression Requirements Medicine +10 ranks

Works automatically: Share the Wound arrives as a Focus reaction ability.
